rows.en: Ankh!! Are you one of OOO's comrades?
What!? You know OOO?
Then when you see OOO, hand him this Medal!
Ankh went off somewhere in pursuit of the Siamese Cat Yummy.
Obtained a new Core Medal! OOO can now use a new skill.
Tch! Hey, you lot, lend me a hand!!
Yeah, like we're just gonna sit here and take it!
I'll show 'em!
All right, let's do this!
Yo!! We meet again!!
So? Did you find Negataros?
{8074} handed the Rider Pass to Momotaros.
Whoa!! You guys are freakin' amazing!! Never thought you'd actually go and get it back!!
Never thought you'd actually go and get it back!!
Wow! Wowww!
Your strength... has made ME cry!
I don't suppose you got the spare Pass back for us too?
Well, actually... we let Negataros get away from us...
So the spare Pass is still...
Nah, truth is... we let Negataros slip away...
So the spare Pass is still...
No... actually, we let Negataros escape...
So the spare Pass is still...
Well, actually... we let Negataros get away from us...
So the spare Pass is still...
Nah, actually... we let Negataros give us the slip...
So the spare Pass is still...
Don't sweat it!
That Negataros is MY prey.
So, which way'd the bastard run?
...Gotcha. That way, huh?
Aaalright!! Here I go, here I go, here I gooo!!!
Here I go, here I go, here I gooo!!!
Ah, Sempai!!
Hold it right there!!
Y-You all...
Hikari!! You okay!?
Ultraman Hikari!! Are you all right!?
Ultraman Hikari!! Are you all right!?
Hikari!! You okay!?
Hikari!! Are you all right!?
I'm sorry... After that, I went after Bogarl...
How careless of me... I ended up getting beaten back instead.
If Mebius hadn't saved me back then, by now I'd be...
So that's what happened... Then where's Mebius!?
I see... Then where is this Ultraman Mebius!?
So that's what happened... Then where is Mebius!?
So that's what happened... Then where's Mebius!?
So that's what happened... Then where is Mebius!?
After Mebius let me escape, enemy reinforcements surrounded him... and they carried him off.
I can't just stay here... I have to... go save him...
The damage Hikari had taken from Bogarl was far worse than it had seemed.
You can't, not with that wound!! Let's get back to base and get you treated!!
You can't, not with that wound. Let's get back to base and treat it.
You can't, not with that wound. Let's get back to base and get you treated!
With that wound, it's impossible. You'd be better off returning to base for treatment.
{8074} and the others returned to base.
Once at the base, Hikari was placed in a regeneration capsule...
...And then...
Brother Hikari...!
Are you okay to be up already!?
Yeah, well enough to move around, anyway.
That's Brother Hikari for you! You bounced back fast!
I owe it to the regeneration capsule.
Is that another piece of equipment that got pulled into the base?
Yeah, and there's all kinds of other stuff too, y'know?
Stuff like this...
This...
And there's this, too.
I see. It looks like all of these would run again if they were repaired.
If you go through the back room, there's a place that's like a big junk heap.
If we dig around there, we might turn up more useful stuff.
Hikari, do you have a moment?
We were just discussing how to rescue Mebius,
and we hoped you might have some kind of lead.
A lead...
Anything at all. Please, tell us.

notes.note: Zeta Gundam (Kamille) asks the same comrade question W/Zero/Nu asked in story_009; 'comrades' for nakama.
'this Medal' kept generic; row 0.166 identifies it as a Core Medal. Ankh asks the listener to deliver it, so the imperative is correct here.
System/notification line, no speaker.
Different branch from 0.163-0.166 (Ankh asks the party to fight alongside him); 0.168-0.170 are party replies.
'Rider Pass' is the established Den-O English term; not in glossary. {8074} = party/leader name variable.
No speaker; truncated alternate of Momotaros's 0.6 line.
Kintaros inverts his catchphrase ('my strength makes you cry' -> 'your strength made me cry'); capital ME keeps the twist.
0.11-0.20: identical Japanese pair for each possible party leader (OOO, W, Nu, Zeta, Zero); light voice variation only, meaning unchanged. Subject 'we' restored (the party let Negataros escape).
Momotaros's rough 'yatsu' rendered 'the bastard' to keep his rudeness toward Negataros (glossary g=m).
Momotaros catchphrase 'Iku ze iku ze iku ze' = 'Here I go, here I go, here I go'. 0.26 is a speakerless alternate of the same shout.
Urataros calls Momotaros 'senpai'; kept as 'Senpai' (standard in Den-O fan English). Not in glossary.
Kintaros's Kansai 'matan-kai' -> 'Hold it right there!!'
OOO adds the honorific -san; dropped rather than inventing a title (consistent with story_002 handling of OOO's -san). Same in 0.14.
'Ore to shita koto ga' = self-reproach ('How careless of me'); 'kaeriuchi' = he went on the attack and was beaten instead. Bogal (g=n) not named, so no pronoun needed.
Mebius is male per glossary; 'they carried him off' restores the agent (the reinforcements) for the passive.

MainEventMess0128 has no recovered speakers. The Base version of this same scene (MainEventMess0902, story_180) has speakers: Zero = 0.6/0.7/0.9/0.12-0.18, Hikari = 0.8/0.10/0.11/0.16/0.22, Nu Gundam = 0.19-0.21; 0.23 unknown (likely Nu). Translated on that basis.

This dungeon variant has the speaker (Zero per the 0902 parallel) call Hikari 'Hikari-niisan'; the 0902 version just says 'Hikari'. Kept faithful as 'Brother Hikari' (Ultra 'Brother X' convention). Odd for Zero; reviewer may want to check which file the game actually shows.
Same 'niisan' as 0.6 -> 'That's my brother for you!'
Hikari is asking about the regeneration capsule (row 0.10); 'that' refers to it.
One sentence cut across 0.20/0.21; English cut at the matching point (comma / lowercase continuation).
Speaker not recovered even in the 0902 parallel; most likely Nu Gundam continuing 0.19-0.21. 'tell us' chosen since the group was discussing the rescue.
proofread: 'my brother' implied literal kinship; source is the Ultra 'Brother X' address (same as 0.6)

report: 80/80 rows examined. MainEventMess0128 speakers inferred from the Base parallel scene MainEventMess0902 (story_180); 0128.6/0.9 'niisan' kept as 'Brother Hikari' though odd for Zero; 0128.23 speaker uncertain (likely Nu Gundam). Names/terms not in glossary: Rider Pass, Senpai, regeneration capsule (from story_002).
